# FlexiBoard

> Plug-and-play multi-board drag-and-drop for Flutter (Dart). Mechanism-first physics, optional default UI, 1..N boards, WIP, undo. MIT license. Package name: `flexi_board`.

Install: `flutter pub add flexi_board`. Public import: `package:flexi_board/flexi_board.dart`. Provide `FlexiBoardController` **or** `FlexiBoardWorkspace`. Card payload is generic `T`. Flutter-only — no required state-management package.

Consumer coding agents: after depending on this package, run `dart run skills@ get` (or `dart run skills@ get --all`) to install the skills below.

- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kikikimbing/flexi_board/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): Version history
- [pub.dev](https://pub.dev/packages/flexi_board): Published package
- [API library barrel](https://github.com/kikikimbing/flexi_board/blob/master/lib/flexi_board.dart): Public exports

## Package skills

- [flexi-board-integrate](https://github.com/kikikimbing/flexi_board/blob/master/skills/flexi-board-integrate/SKILL.md): Add FlexiBoard, controller vs host-owned state, custom cards, applyMove
- [flexi-board-integrate API](https://github.com/kikikimbing/flexi_board/blob/master/skills/flexi-board-integrate/references/api.md): Public type cheat sheet
- [flexi-board-layouts](https://github.com/kikikimbing/flexi_board/blob/master/skills/flexi-board-layouts/SKILL.md): single / tabs / sideBySide / paged, physics, columnListWrapper
- [flexi-board-policies](https://github.com/kikikimbing/flexi_board/blob/master/skills/flexi-board-policies/SKILL.md): WIP, canStartDrag vs canAcceptDrop, undo/redo
